rows.name: value
rows.description: Controlled value, or null for no selection.

rows.name: onChange
rows.description: Fired with the new date (or null when the input is cleared).

rows.name: display
rows.description: Text input + popover calendar, an always-visible inline calendar, or a trigger button that opens the calendar in a modal with Apply / Cancel.

rows.name: minDate
rows.description: Earliest selectable date (inclusive). Out-of-range days are disabled.

rows.name: maxDate
rows.description: Latest selectable date (inclusive).

rows.name: futureOnly
rows.description: Restrict to future dates — today and earlier disabled. Shorthand for minDate=tomorrow; an explicit minDate overrides it. For scheduling / expiries / 'remind me on…' pickers.

rows.name: validators
rows.description: Arbitrary day-disabling predicates (return false to disable). Combined with minDate/maxDate/futureOnly. Use for holidays, blackout windows, weekends.

rows.name: rangeStart
rows.description: Highlight the span from this date to the hovered/selected day — for paired range pickers.

rows.name: locale
rows.description: BCP-47 locale for month names (e.g. "fr-FR").

rows.name: monthFormat
rows.description: Override month-name rendering (takes priority over locale).

rows.name: allowRelative
rows.description: Add an 'In…' tab beside the calendar — a relative offset that resolves to a date (or an ISO duration, see relativeMode).

rows.name: relativeMode
rows.description: What the In… tab produces: a weeks/days offset resolved to an absolute date via onChange (default), or a days/hours/minutes offset emitted as an ISO-8601 duration (e.g. "PT2H30M") via onDurationChange.

rows.name: onDurationChange
rows.description: Fired with the ISO-8601 duration string when relativeMode="duration".

rows.name: relativeOnly
rows.description: Show only the relative entry — drop the calendar tab. With relativeMode="duration", a pure duration picker; otherwise a pure relative-date picker.

rows.name: durationValue
rows.description: Controlled duration shown in the field when no date is selected (the last value from onDurationChange), e.g. "PT2H30M" — so the input/trigger reflects a chosen duration instead of sitting empty.

rows.name: relativeHelpText
rows.description: Optional helper line above the days/hours/minutes steppers (relativeMode="duration").

rows.name: relativeTabLabel / dateTabLabel
rows.description: Tab labels when allowRelative (i18n). Default "In…" / "Specific date".

rows.name: isDisabled
rows.description: Disable the control.

rows.name: ariaLabel
rows.description: Accessible name (popover input / flat calendar).

rows.name: placeholder
rows.description: Placeholder for the popover input.

rows.name: rangeError
rows.description: Message shown when an out-of-range date is typed (popover).

rows.name: modalTitle
rows.description: Modal title (display="modal").

rows.name: applyText
rows.description: Modal apply-button text (display="modal").

rows.name: cancelText
rows.description: Modal cancel-button text (display="modal").
